description: Adds faction flags inspired by various science fiction franchises. Includes two series of flags covering factions from games and media such as Starcraft, Star Wars, Star Trek, Halo, and Fallout.

discordPostHtml:
This mod adds a bunch of flags from various sci-fi factions.

A list of factions are as follows:

SERIES 1 (version 1.0)
-----------------------------------------
-Raynor's Raiders from Starcraft II
-First Galactic Empire from Star Wars
-United Federation of Planets from Star Trek
-Brotherhood of Nod from Command & Conquer (updated to a more accurate flag)
-Minutemen from Fallout 4
-Stormcloak Rebellion from Skyrim
-Stargate Command from Stargate SG-1
-Martian Congressional Republic from The Expanse
-UNSC from Halo
-United Citizen Federation from Starship Troopers
-Empire of Achenar from Elite: Dangerous
-Hiigaran Empire from Homeworld 3
-Aperture Science from Portal
-The Institute of Science from Fallout 4

SERIES 2 (version 1.3)
-----------------------------------------
-Terran Dominion from Starcraft 2
-Rebel Alliance from Star Wars
-Klingon Empire from Star Trek
-Third Empire from Skyrim
-Covenant from Halo
-Black Mesa from Half Life
-House Atreides from Dune
-Earth Alliance from Babylon 5
-GDI from Command and Conquer
-The Vagyr from Homeworld 2
-Romulan Republic from Star Trek
-Brotherhood of Steel from Fallout

Lots of flags used in this project were created by the /r/Vexilology subreddit! Please check it out if you're interested in flag design.
